scope: W17-02 candidate 1971e48be4e2989383d74060faf15bcd0f95cb73; awaiting main integration and exact registered dispatch evidence

source_review.finding: OWNER or VERIFIER must also hold restricted project grant. Read and registration release their initial transaction before provider IO and reauthenticate afterwards. Independent fixture rerun proves role removal, grant removal, credential revocation, stale artifact, corrupt body, provider readiness loss, redacted provider error and revoked registration return no private bytes/persisted registration. OWNER plus PLANNER is expressly allowed by the frozen contract.

source_review.surface: API metadata, list, events and context references
source_review.finding: Known protected IDs pass readObject and visibleGraphKind; list rows and reference graphs are filtered before publication. Event and context references inherit visibility of protected artifacts. Raw C22 audit was reparsed for candidate marker and private metadata leakage, with real successful list controls and known-ID denials.

Real content route revalidates and sends no-store plus sandbox/nosniff/download headers. Search calls readObject before kind checks or index use; its exact private-ID refusal is authorization evidence. Native/HTTP evidence does not establish separate preview, export, log or backup routes: guessed 404s are excluded from capability claims. Database cache/marker scans and exact credential/grant-aware current reads cover the tested cache boundary, not arbitrary caches.

Existing local backup engine rejects protected versions; actual destination-not-published check exists. Context materialization rejects protected artifacts before destination creation. Raw native evidence proves four distinct zero-capability AppContainers receive only individual synthetic questions and cannot read/write listed private targets. Host same-user positive controls remain readable, so this does not establish independent formal Verifier identity.

Provider errors are mapped to generic error messages. New injected private provider error returns 503 without marker. Raw C22 generated server logs and database/event marker scans are clean. This covers these generated logs and controlled failures, not every exception stack.

CanaryStore reports IndependentIdentity=false and UnrestrictedSameUserCanRead=true and refuses LIVE. FrozenProvider.Read intentionally refuses control-host body export. Existing protected summary, ImportFrozenQualifications, prepareQualification, acceptQualification and recordQualificationResult form a separate production path; its service and formal data were not probed. Different same-user agents are not an independent OS boundary. No full C22/A11/C07, LIVE qualification, BOUNDED_AUTO or parent acceptance follows from this review.
